mapper.sql: i.uuid, i.external_id, i.email, i.role, CASE WHEN i.status = 'pending' AND i.expires_at <= now() THEN 'expired' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.invited_at, i.expires_at, COALESCE((SELECT d.status FROM platform_admin_invite_deliveries d WHERE d.organization_uuid = i.organization_uuid AND d.invitation_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.uuid DESC LIMIT 1), 'not_queued') AS delivery_status
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_invites WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND lower(email) = lower(#{email}) AND status = 'pending' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now()) AS pending
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_invites (uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, email, role, status, invited_at, expires_at, platform_actor_uuid) VALUES (#{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Email}, #{params.Role}, 'pending', now(), now() + interval '21 days', #{params.AccountUUID}) RETURNING uuid, external_id, email, role, status, invited_at, expires_at, 'pending' AS delivery_status
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_invites SET status = 'pending', invited_at = now(), expires_at = now() + interval '21 days' WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND uuid = #{invitationUUID}
UPDATE organization_invites SET status = 'deleted', deleted_at = now() WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND uuid = #{invitationUUID}
